//: Solution file for `pnpm typecheck` (tsc -b). Reference every workspace so a
new package is one line away from being type-checked in CI.
`tsc -b` verifies types and writes no output (noEmit comes from
`pnpm build` runs the SAME graph with the emit switch flipped on the command
line — `tsc -b --noCheck --noEmit false` — so typecheck and build share one
configuration and cannot drift apart, then bundles the apps with Vite.
Note: packages/core/tsconfig.json extends tsconfig.core.json (no DOM lib).
